## Problem and expected behavior

State the concrete problem and observable outcome. Link the PLAN item, requirement IDs, and relevant ADRs; distinguish accepted behavior from proposals.

## Scope and non-goals

List affected boundaries and what is outside this item. Record dependencies and unresolved decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable result, including relevant failure or interruption behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and plan updates.

## Implementation and delegation

Name the accountable lead, suitable independent workstreams, file/worktree ownership, model constraints, and resource limits. Keep the plan proportionate.

## Verification and evidence

Identify meaningful behavior checks and relevant A-series scenarios. Record failing baseline where applicable, actual results, evidence paths, review findings, and unverified integrations. Prose-only work uses source/link/consistency checks.

## Completion

- [ ] Criteria met and relevant checks actually run.
- [ ] Review findings resolved or explicitly tracked.
- [ ] Requirements, docs, examples, and PLAN status agree.
- [ ] Limitations and follow-ups recorded.
